name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Route 1)
expected_outcome: Message routes through Message Mapping 1 to EndEvent_2; headers enriched and logged via Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy; HTTP 202/200 received.
validates: Content Modifier 'Set Message headers', Router sequence flow 'SequenceFlow_82', Message Mapping step, and header logging.

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Route 2)
expected_outcome: Message routes directly via SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71 ('Call Headers') and concludes at EndEvent_9 without mapping failure.
validates: Router condition SequenceFlow_113, CallActivity_71, and EndEvent_9 termination.

name: Routing Condition Not Met - Escalation End
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with unmatched routing parameters (e.g., OrderTypeCode 'UNKNOWN')
expected_outcome: Router defaults to SequenceFlow_110 leading to EscalationEndEvent 'EndEvent_11' with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.
validates: Default route SequenceFlow_110 and EscalationEndEvent handling.

name: Transformation Failure triggers Error Subprocess
trigger: Inbound SOAP payload with broken XML syntax causing Message Mapping 1 runtime exception.
expected_outcome: Exception Subprocess 1 caught the error; CallActivity_97 restores 'InputPayload' from property; CallActivity_100 logs original payload; flow ends in EndErrorEvent EndEvent_95.

name: Boundary Test - Inbound Message with Empty Body
trigger: SOAP envelope with empty body content.
expected_outcome: Property InputPayload contains empty string; router defaults to escalation or triggers exception handler.
validates: CallActivity_4 boundary behavior when ${in.body} is empty string.

name: Generic Header and Parameter Injection Verification
trigger: Standard SOAP envelope with configured environment parameters for Region, Country, Sender, TimeStamp.
expected_outcome: All message headers defined in CallActivity_4 are transferred to custom header properties in message log.
validates: External parameter placeholder injection ({{Region}}, {{Country}}, {{TimeStamp}}, {{BusinessObject}}, {{Sender}}) and script execution.
